t: High-quality low odour, low VOC water-based interior trim paint. Easy-to-apply with excellent flow and high-opacity. Hard-wearing and durable and scratch, stain and grease-resistant. Non-yellowing. Quick-drying paint is recoatable in 2-4 hours. For best results use over LickPro topcoat-enhancing Interior and Exterior Primer and Undercoat, and with LickPro Walls and Ceilings paints (sold separately).
